replication.target_description: Single replication experiment, retrospective motivation; proximity ANOVA across first-trial schedules 1/4, 1/3, 1/2, 1/1 (effort held at 1).

n.sample_role: Participants retained in final analysis; retrospective self-report motivation ratings.
n.exclusions: Ten excluded participants replaced: recording problems (2), memory error (1), electrodes falling off (2), guessing strategy (1), fewer than 7 observations in a cell (4). Practice/error/RT >500 ms/RT=0 trials and incorrect-confirmation schedules excluded in behavioral analyses.
n.location: Methods, Participants; Data analysis, Behavioral data
n.quote: In total 32 participants (recruited via the local Sona system from Ghent University) completed the experiment between March and July 2023 and remained in the final analysis

es.location: Table 1, Proximity effect, 1/4, 1/3, 1/2, 1/1 row, Motivation column

p.location: Table 1, Proximity effect, 1/4, 1/3, 1/2, 1/1 row, Motivation column

reported_success.quote: In sum, we were able to replicate the effects (or the absence of the effects) of proximity and effort on arrow RTs and confirm RTs, and self-reported motivation and frustration at the end of the experiment.

notes: No primary project-table URL supplied; extracted matching rows in primary paper Table 1 independently. Original source is an author proof with internal proof pagination. Table caption labels original tests as linear effects; replication describes univariate ANOVAs. Retained each printed F and p from its own motivation/proximity first-trial test, without conversion. Degrees of freedom not printed in either table. Original enrolled N=27 is not silently treated as a printed analytic n. Author narrative explicitly calls the motivation/proximity effects replicated, but does not separately name this individual schedule-row test in its verdict.
